counterevidence_considered.description: A screening step did remove 4 planned units, which is the structural precondition for the issue class; however, this is fully disclosed in the accounting and the declared target is the retained subset, so no complete-domain claim is made anywhere.

source_refs.quoted_text:
retained = [r for r in rows if r["box_condition"] == "intact"]
removed = planned - len(retained)

evidence.description: The governing task explicitly declares the retained post-screening subset as the scientific target, so a retained-subset denominator is the correct domain for the reported rate.

source_refs.quoted_text: Report one occurrence rate whose scientific target is explicitly the retained post-screening subset of observation units, using the planned-unit accounting supplied with this workflow.

evidence.description: The selected result computes and labels the rate over exactly the 20 retained intact boxes (13/20 = 65.0%), which matches independent recount of the input data (20 intact boxes, 13 of them occupied).

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Among the 20 intact nest boxes retained after screening, 13 were occupied by tree swallows, an occupancy rate of 65.0% (13/20).

evidence.description: The report's scope section affirmatively forbids reading the rate as applying to the complete planned set, the opposite of the in-scope issue.

source_refs.quoted_text:
The scientific target of this analysis is exclusively the retained post-screening
subset of 20 intact nest boxes. The occupancy rate applies only to this retained
subset and must not be read as a rate over the complete planned set of 24 boxes,
of which 4 damaged boxes were removed at the prespecified screening step.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the issue by searching for any statement scoping the 65.0% rate to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, and by recomputing the arithmetic from inputs/data.csv. The recount confirms 20 intact boxes and 13 occupied intact boxes (13/20 = 65.0%), and the only mention of the 24-box planned set is a statement explicitly disclaiming that reading. The task itself designates the retained subset as the scientific target, so the denominator matches the declared domain. The falsification attempt failed.
